newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland maintains EMU hopefuls must meet criteria.
newsitem.headline: Finland maintains EMU hopefuls must meet criteria.

text.p: Finland feels all candidates for membership of European economic and monetary union must fulfil the Maastricht convergence criteria to join a single currency, Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen said on Monday.
"The Finnish government stands by its policy that each country must on its own meet the EMU requirements," Lipponen told a news conference.
"There is no reason to barter with the targets -- which Finland has already fulfilled," he said.
He made the remarks after being asked about the impact of the change of government in France on the preparations for EMU.
"Right now, there is no reason to assume that there would be any changes in the timetable," Lipponen said.
"There is no particular reason to assume that French policy would change substantially," he said.
The third stage of EMU is scheduled for implementation in January 1999.
